text:
Jared: Quick async check — where are we on the microbatch kernel landing this sprint? Need an owners matrix for: kernel PR, KV prefetch, and the infra shm change. Can we get a short status + any blockers by EOD?

Priya: I can own KV prefetch. PR #6182 is up and passes unit tests, but I need a review from Alex for the API changes (added PrefetchPolicy enum).

Alex: Looking in a bit — heads up I hit a memmap shrink on my local repro, likely due to shared-mem layout change from the kernel patch. I'll try to reproduce with Priya's branch. @eng-infra-bot do we have capacity to bump the default shm to 256MB on canaries?

eng-infra-bot: Requested quota check submitted (REQ-2026). ETA from infra team: ~24h. Will post here when approved.

Maya: I can take kernel PR review after Alex gives go on the memmap issue. Also flagging: performance test harness needs a small tweak to the batching window threshold; I'll open a tiny PR (no product changes).

Noah: FYI, the canary rollout for continuous batching depends on the autoscaler change in infra ticket TICKET-1293 — that's currently in queued review with infra. If it slips we'll need a manual throughput cap for the canary nodes.

Alex: Reproduced memmap shrink with Priya's branch. Short term patch: revert the index alignment in kernel v2 until shm bump lands. Suggest we gate PR #6244 (kernel) behind infra approval or use the revert. Which do we prefer?

Jared: Let's avoid reverting kernel if possible — losing kernel perf improvements is painful. Proposal: hold kernel PR but merge KV prefetch and the batching threshold tweak to unblock downstream work. If infra can confirm shm bump within 24h, we'll proceed with kernel without revert. Anyone strongly against?

Priya: Fine with that. I'll add a feature flag for PrefetchPolicy so we can toggle if something goes wrong in canary. PR #6182 updated with flag + docs.

Maya: Opening the small perf harness PR now: #6199 — removes hard cutoff at 8ms for batching simulation.

Noah: I'll add a temporary throughput cap script for canary nodes in ops repo and link it here: https://git.redwood/ops/canary-cap (will post patch in ~2h).

Jared: Owners summary (please confirm):
- Kernel PR #6244: Jared owner (hold, pending shm bump)
- KV prefetch PR #6182: Priya owner (merge ok w/ feature flag)
- Batching harness PR #6199: Maya owner (merge)
- Infra shm bump REQ-2026 / TICKET-1293: eng-infra team (blocking for kernel)
- Canary throughput cap: Noah (ops script)

If everyone confirms, I'll update the sprint board and add a short note to the release checklist about the shm bump dependency.

Alex: Confirm. I'll follow up with eng-infra folks on REQ-2026.

Priya: Confirmed. I'll watch canaries and the feature flag rollout.

Maya: Confirmed, merging #6199 after CI.

Noah: Confirmed, will post cap script PR shortly.

deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly deploy freeze starts in 48h. If this needs to land before freeze, flag it in the release checklist.

Jared: Noted — if infra can't unblock kernel before freeze we'll ship KV prefetch + harness and defer kernel until post-freeze. Thanks all.
